excerpts.author: ethdreamer
excerpts.content:
For Lighthouse's new image, no distributed XMSS cache is required: this is local signing-tree caching/loading. First startup still derives the key from the existing keystore and computes the needed trees; subsequent starts reuse the local cache. This doesn't decide whether Barnabas wants to distribute precomputed caches to accelerate first startup too.

You're right to flag upgrading the entire leanVM branch. We did **not** do that. Agent implementation reference:

- Keep verifier, aggregation guest, claims, sidecar and shared Keccak at `283686575c4e81790591d2c6e3ed21c69c0e3bbe`.
- Backport only PR #802's XMSS `scheme.rs`/`tree.rs` cache changes into a separate signer crate. Public keys/signature bytes remain identical; we checked boundary vectors against the pinned signer and proved/verified them with the pinned sidecar.
- Persist the top tree + bounded recently used bottom trees. Restore with the existing seed and authenticated expected public key; validate tree roots/signatures, bound input sizes and reject duplicate subtree indices. Missing/invalid caches rebuild.
- Our local file envelope is versioned and HMAC-authenticated using a domain-separated key derived from the XMSS seed; it isn't a cross-client distribution format. Write atomically, and precompute upcoming slot/attestation trees in a bounded background worker. Leaf reservations remain in the separate durable slashing DB.

Backport/provenance: https://github.com/ethDreamer/lighthouse/tree/9deb902a682900fa9f7b1d0dd6daa260eecf0bbd/crypto/lean_xmss_compact
Local cache integration: https://github.com/ethDreamer/lighthouse/blob/9deb902a682900fa9f7b1d0dd6daa260eecf0bbd/validator_client/lighthouse_validator_store/src/xmss_cache.rs

excerpts.author: ethdreamer
excerpts.content:
Yes — 2^10 cached nodes per tree, at 16 bytes/node = 16 KiB/tree. That's the retained cache size; generating those nodes initially still requires computing the underlying leaves.

For PR #802's raw cache format:
• Top tree: 16,384 bytes.
• Each cached bottom tree: 17,588 bytes (16,384 nodes + 1,200-byte top-layer signature + 4-byte tree index).
• Top + current attestation/proposal bottoms: 51,560 bytes per validator; 515.6 MB total for 10k validators, uncompressed.
• Including the next bottom in each range: 86,736 bytes per validator; 867.36 MB for 10k.

For devnet-0 at genesis, the current bottom indices are 0 (attestations) and 24576 (proposal/slot duties); next are 1 and 24577. Clients could fetch only their assigned validators' records.

We tested an upstream #802 cache with those two current bottoms against Lighthouse's backport: imported in ~0.6 ms, generated byte-identical signatures, and verified with the deployed leanVM pin. So the decoder is compatible. The remaining integration is publishing those raw cache records with a validator-index mapping and wiring an importer; the existing .bin public keys and .vrf artifact don't contain these signing trees.

ethDreamer
1. Everything. devnet-0 moves to leanVM bindings v0.15.0 (c5ee9d239) for signer, prover/verifier and sidecar. One version, no backports, and nothing is live yet so now is the cheapest time. <@&1573153274616356916> please rebuild on that commit for Monday.
2. Yes please, we need --xmss-cache-url so we can do kurtosis tests with fast startup. If the flag is unset, the fetch fails or the cache is refused, fall back to building the trees like today. The artifact is ready for the first 1024 keys, the full 10k is generating now:
    •    URL: https://panda-uploads-production.devops-539.workers.dev/panda/uploads/e0eeab/b9dec4e1daa17dfe.xmss (the 10k file will get a new URL, I'll post it)
    •    Layout: raw v0.15.0 cache_to_bytes output, no framing, 14696 bytes per key = top tree (4096) + bottom 0 for attestations (5300) + bottom 24576 for slot duties (5300)
    •    Mapping: record i is key index i of the default mnemonic, same order and derivation as the existing .bin pubkey file. Range request bytes i*14696 to (i+1)*14696-1 to fetch only your own keys
    •    Load with from_cache_bytes(seed, public_key, bytes), it checks the bytes against the pubkey so the file doesn't need to be trusted
    •    ethereum-package pq branch has xmss_cache_url, passed to the VC as --xmss-cache-url=<url or path>. I'll default it once the images accept the flag
3. Land it on the existing pq-devnet-0 branch and replace ethpandaops/lighthouse:pq-devnet-0. Genesis, key derivation and VRF artifacts stay the same, so no artifact update. All client images need to be on v0.15.0 together, since proofs from the old pin won't verify against the new one.
